text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Yippee! Helpful Samurai Tokujiro is on today. Hehehe, I've been waiting for this all week. ♪

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
We interrupt the previously scheduled 
programming to bring you breaking news on
reports of an unidentified flying
object over
Fuchu!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh my... A breaking news report...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
But I was so looking forward to seeing
what
Tokujiro is up to this week...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute is quite down after the
show she's
been looking forward to gets
bumped by a
breaking news report.
